title: TAD: Distilling Vision-Language-Action Policies from Teacher Trajectories Alone
abstract: arXiv:2610.33650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online distillation of vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly relies on teacher action scores that an inference-only interface may not expose. Trajectory-only Adversarial Distillation (\gad{}) instead turns a fixed bank of teacher joint-position features into adaptive feedback: a discriminator compares feature marginals from teacher and student rollouts and supplies rewards for on-policy learning. The student interacts with the environment without online teacher queries or environment task rewards. On ManiSkill \texttt{PutOnPlateInScene25Main}, \gad{} improves OpenVLA-OFT (7B) from $26.2\%$ to $76.6\%$ \successonce{} ($+50.4$ percentage points) and from $20.3\%$ to $58.6\%$ \successend{}. It trails white-box on-policy distillation (OPD) at $81.6\%$ / $59.4\%$ by $5.0$ / $0.8$ percentage points ($n{=}256$ evaluation trajectories per checkpoint). The tested four-epoch continuation achieves the highest \gad{} result without addition

translated_title: TAD：仅从教师轨迹蒸馏视觉-语言-动作策略
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的在线蒸馏通常依赖于教师动作分数，而仅推理接口可能不会暴露这些分数。仅轨迹对抗蒸馏（TAD）则将固定的教师关节位置特征库转化为自适应反馈：判别器比较来自教师和学生轨迹的特征边缘分布，并为在线策略学习提供奖励。学生模型在与环境交互时无需在线查询教师，也无需环境任务奖励。在ManiSkill的PutOnPlateInScene25Main任务上，TAD将OpenVLA-OFT（7B）的首次成功率从26.2%提升至76.6%（+50.4个百分点），最终成功率从20.3%提升至58.6%。其性能比白盒在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的81.6%/59.4%分别低5.0和0.8个百分点（每个检查点使用n=256条评估轨迹）。经测试的四轮延续训练在不增加额外条件的情况下达到了最高的TAD结果。
tldr: 提出仅轨迹对抗蒸馏方法TAD，通过判别器将固定的教师关节位置特征库转化为自适应奖励信号，使学生VLA策略无需在线查询教师或环境任务奖励即可学习，在ManiSkill任务上将OpenVLA-OFT的首次成功率提升50.4个百分点。
en_tdlr: TAD converts a fixed bank of teacher joint-position features into adaptive rewards via a discriminator, enabling VLA policy distillation without online teacher queries or environment task rewards, and boosts OpenVLA-OFT's first-attempt success rate by 50.4 percentage points on ManiSkill.
